title: 第15章 不甘离去第16章 意外之喜
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 自己因一时之快，导致祖母今天和方府落到如此严峻的险境。
方云逸带着一丝懊恼，但更多的是一种冰冷的决意。
若是事不可为，他会暴露出手，亲手斩了这徐长老，尽力带着祖母逃出京都。
但此刻，显然还没有到那个地步，他在等，等监视方府的人出现。
在此之前，他还要需要完美地扮演着濒死病秧子的角色。眼神涣散，呼吸微弱急促，连抬起手指的力气似乎都已失去。
只是偶尔发出一两声压抑不住的、痛苦的轻咳，仿佛下一刻就会油尽灯枯。
庭院中的气氛剑拔弩张，徐长老周身元气隐隐鼓荡，大有一言不合便要再次出手、甚至血洗方府的架势。
老太君手持先皇御赐的宝剑，虽武力不及徐长老，但那决绝的姿态与悲愤的目光，似乎构成最后一道脆弱的屏障。
府内闻讯赶来的老卒目眦欲裂，挡在方云逸和老太君身前，准备拼死一搏。
而就在这千钧一发之际，府门外传来一阵沉稳而富有节奏的脚步声，伴随着一个略显尖细却透着威严的声音。
“圣上口谕到——！”
众人循声望去，只见一名身着深紫色内侍官服、面白无须的中年太监，在一队约二十人、盔甲鲜明、气息精悍的羽林卫簇拥下，缓步走进了方府庭院。
这名内侍目光扫过满院狼藉和紧张对峙的众人，最后落在气势汹汹的徐长老身上，脸上挤出一丝不失礼数的笑容。
“徐长老，久仰玄云宗大名。”
内侍微微颔首，语气颇为和善，但话语内容却带着不容置疑的份量。
“方家乃是功勋之后，老太君更是朝廷诰命。您这般在方府动怒，恐怕于理不合，有损玄云宗清誉。”
“还请长老息怒，一切，自有圣裁。”
他顿了顿，声音提高了几分，清晰传遍整个庭院。“奉陛下口谕，传方府老太君林氏，即刻入宫面圣！”
口谕落下，内侍转身看向徐长老！
“玄云宗弟子遇害一事，陛下已有听闻，深感痛心，已令京兆尹、刑部及皇城司全力侦办，定会给徐长老一个交代。”
“是非曲直，必会查明，绝不会冤枉无辜，亦不会放过真凶。”
这番话，如同一盆冰水，瞬间浇熄徐长老即将爆发的雷霆之怒。他的脸色变幻不定，胸膛剧烈起伏，显然极不甘心。
但他再狂妄，也深知眼前代表的是大乾皇帝，是这京都、这大乾王朝名义上的最高主宰。
玄云宗虽强，却也不会为了一个内门弟子、去公然对抗一朝帝皇旨意的地步。
若是他强行在此刻发难，不仅占不到丝毫便宜，反而会立刻将玄云宗置于朝廷的对立面，那后果绝非他一个外门长老所能承担。
徐长老重重冷哼一声，强行压下翻腾的杀意，目光如毒蛇般再次扫过奄奄一息的方云逸和悲愤交加的老太君。
“既然陛下有旨，那老夫便在林府拭目以待，希望陛下真能给我玄云宗一个公道。我们走！”
content_en:
Because of his quickness, his grandmother and the Fang Mansion fell into such a serious danger today.
Fang Yunyi felt a little annoyed, but more of a cold determination.
If things couldn't be done, he would show his hand, kill Elder Xu with his own hands, and try his best to escape from Kyoto with his grandmother.
But at this moment, it was obvious that he had not reached that point yet. He was waiting for the person monitoring Fang Mansion to appear.
Before that, he still needs to perfectly play the role of the dying sick man. His eyes were distracted, his breathing was weak and rapid, and he seemed to have lost the strength to lift his fingers.
I only occasionally let out one or two unsuppressed, painful coughs, as if the fuel would run out in the next moment.
The atmosphere in the courtyard was tense. Elder Xu's vitality was faintly surging, and he was ready to take action again or even bloodbath the Fang Mansion if he disagreed with him.
The old lady holds the sword given by the late emperor. Although her force is not as good as Elder Xu's, her decisive posture and sad and angry eyes seem to form the last fragile barrier.
The old soldier who came to the mansion after hearing the news had his eyes split open, and stood in front of Fang Yunyi and the old lady, ready to fight to the death.
And at this critical moment, there was a steady and rhythmic sound of footsteps outside the house, accompanied by a slightly high-pitched but majestic voice.
“The Holy Spirit has spoken—!”
Everyone followed the sound and saw a middle-aged eunuch wearing a dark purple chamberlain uniform with a white face and no beard, slowly walking into the courtyard of the Fang Mansion, surrounded by a group of about 20 Yulin guards with bright armor and powerful auras.
The servant's eyes swept across the messy courtyard and the tense confrontations among the people, and finally fell on the aggressive Elder Xu, with a polite smile on his face.
"Elder Xu, I have admired the famous name of Xuanyun Sect for a long time."
The chamberlain nodded slightly and his tone was quite kind, but the content of his words carried unquestionable weight.
"The Fang family is the queen of meritorious deeds, and the old lady is a royal decree. You are so angry in the Fang Mansion, I am afraid it is unreasonable and will damage the reputation of the Xuanyun Sect."
"Elder please calm down, everything will be decided by the Holy Spirit."
He paused, and his voice rose a bit, clearly spreading throughout the courtyard. "According to His Majesty's oral instructions, the old lady of the Fang Mansion, Mrs. Lin, will enter the palace immediately to meet the saint!"
After finishing the oral instruction, the chamberlain turned to look at Elder Xu!
"Your Majesty has heard about the murder of the Xuanyun Sect disciples and is deeply saddened. He has ordered Jing Zhaoyin, the Criminal Department and the Imperial City Department to investigate with all their strength, and will definitely give Elder Xu an explanation."
"The right and wrong will be determined. The innocent will never be wronged, and the real culprit will not be let go."
These words were like a basin of ice water, instantly dousing Elder Xu's thunderous anger that was about to burst out. His expression was changing, his chest was rising and falling violently, and he was obviously very unwilling to do so.
But no matter how arrogant he is, he still knows that the person in front of him is the Emperor of Daqian, the nominal supreme ruler of Kyoto and the Daqian Dynasty.
Although Xuanyun Sect is strong, it will not go to the point of openly defying the emperor's will for the sake of an inner disciple.
If he forced the attack at this moment, not only would he not be able to gain any advantage, but he would immediately put the Xuanyun Sect on the opposite side of the court. The consequences would be beyond what he, an outer sect elder, could bear.
"Hmph!"
Elder Xu snorted heavily and suppressed the roiling murderous intent. His eyes swept over the dying Fang Yunyi and the grief-stricken old lady again like a poisonous snake.
"Since His Majesty has a decree, I will wait and see in the Lin Mansion. I hope that Your Majesty can really give my Xuanyun Sect justice. Let's go!"
